name: SPIE SA
reason: Multi-technical services contractor whose adjusted EPS grew EUR 1.11 (2015) to 2.69 (2025) largely via bolt-on M&A (acq/FCF 0.51, shares +2.9%/yr) on a 5.8% EBIT margin at the 91st pctile with 10y avg ROIC only 4.9%; acquisition-led, labour-based, no moat.

name: Magyar Telekom Telecommunications PLC
reason: DT-controlled Hungarian telco whose EPS jumped HUF 82 (2023) to 229 (2025) on inflation-indexed pricing with EBIT margin at a 10y high (26.9% vs 14.7% avg) while consensus sees only 3-4% growth FY1-FY2 and Hungarian windfall-tax/price-cap policy sets the outcome.

name: Klepierre SA
reason: Shopping-centre REIT with FFO/share only EUR 1.93 (2015) to 2.72 (2025) (3.5%/yr), net debt/EBITDA 7.3x and consensus/LTG growth of 2-3.5%; leveraged mature real estate with no route to 7%.

name: Synsam AB
reason: Nordic optical retailer with a subscription model and EPS SEK 2.19 (2022) to 3.14 (2025) plus 15-26% consensus growth, but only ~4 years of public history, ROIC 6.7% avg and net debt 1.9x EBITDA leave durability untested in a soft consumer market.

name: Lottomatica Group S.P.A.
reason: Italian gaming operator whose growth is bought (acq/FCF 2.41, net debt/EBITDA 2.7x) and whose earnings depend on state concession renewals and gaming-tax policy; 10y avg ROIC 2.7% and a 163% adjusted-vs-GAAP gap.

name: Jungheinrich AG
reason: Forklift/intralogistics maker with EPS EUR 1.34 to 2.69 over 10y (7.2%/yr) but only 4/10 years >=7%, consensus FY1 -17% on the capex cycle, EBIT margin 6.5% and rising low-cost Chinese forklift competition; cyclical and ordinary.

name: Compagnie de Saint-Gobain SA
reason: Construction materials with adjusted EPS EUR 2.04 to 6.70 but now 0.96x its 10y max with EBIT margin at a 10y high (10.7% vs 8.6% avg, 91st pctile) and consensus FY1 -7%; near-cyclical-peak rule as for CRH, plus M&A-led portfolio reshaping (acq/FCF 0.54).

name: Bilfinger SE
reason: Industrial services turnaround whose EBIT margin of 5.0% is its 10y high (avg 1.6%, losses in 2016-17 and 2020), revenue -1.8%/yr over 10y and 10y avg ROIC 2.8%; low-moat contractor with consensus FY1 -24%.

name: Hrvatski Telekom d.d.
reason: Croatian incumbent telco with adjusted EPS down 2.2%/yr over 10y (EUR 3.87 in 2015 vs 3.10 in 2025), consensus FY1 -33% and LTG 2%; mature regulated telecom with no growth route.

name: Amcor PLC
reason: Packaging consolidator with adjusted EPS (USD) only 3.08 (FY19) to 4.02 (FY26), 1.6%/yr over 5y, shares +7%/yr and net debt/EBITDA 4.0x after the Berry merger; growth from acquisitions and leverage, commodity-resin pass-through.

name: Continental AG
reason: Auto/tyre group whose adjusted EPS fell from EUR 9.51 (2015) to -0.83 (2025) amid restructurings and spin-offs, revenue -6.7%/yr and 10y avg ROIC 5.6%; cyclical auto exposure with no forecastable earnings base.

name: Compagnie des Alpes SA
reason: Caisse des Depots-controlled ski-lift and leisure-park operator with 10y FCF conversion 0.19, acq/FCF 3.32, net debt 3.2x EBITDA and ROIC 2.3%, plus a credible climate threat to snow-dependent ski earnings.

name: Birkenstock Holding plc
reason: Strong brand with 26.4% EBIT margin and EPS EUR 1.02 (FY24) to 1.87 (FY25), but margin is at its short-history high, only 5 years of reported data post-LBO, sponsor control, fashion-cycle durability is unproven and the US-heavy mix adds USD translation and tariff risk.

name: LondonMetric Property PLC
reason: UK logistics/long-income REIT that grew via share-funded acquisitions (shares +13.8%/yr) with net debt/EBITDA 6.9x and consensus growth of only 3-4%/yr (LTG 3.5%); no per-share route to 7%.

name: Chemical Works of Gedeon Richter Plc
reason: EPS HUF 284 to 1,271 over 10y (16%/yr) with EBIT margin at a 10y high (32.4% vs 21.3% avg) driven by cariprazine (Vraylar) royalties from AbbVie whose US exclusivity ends around 2029, plus Hungarian windfall-tax policy; a credible 5-yr patent cliff and partner concentration.

name: Schaeffler AG
reason: Auto-component supplier with adjusted EPS falling from EUR 1.47 (2017) to losses in 2024-25, EBIT margin at 9th pctile (2.7%), shares +4.4%/yr after the Vitesco merger and ICE-to-EV transition risk; cyclical with a technology threat.

name: Corporacion America Airports S.A.
reason: Airport concessionaire dominated by Argentina, with EPS (USD) swinging from -1.58 (2020) to 1.53 (2025), 10y avg ROIC 3.2% and earnings set by Argentine macro/FX and concession regulators; not forecastable.

name: Premier Foods plc
reason: Steady UK ambient-food brands (Mr Kipling, Bisto) with EPS GBP 0.08 to 0.16 over 10y (6.9%/yr) but EBIT margin at its 10y high (17.6% vs 13.4% avg), 10y avg ROIC 3.9% and consensus growth of only 0-6% (LTG 3%); good but ordinary, no route to 7%.

name: Dermapharm Holding SE
reason: Off-patent pharma whose EPS of EUR 2.50 (2025) is still 36% below the 2021 BioNTech-vaccine peak of 3.91, with growth via acquisitions (acq/FCF 0.84), net debt 2.7x EBITDA and LTG 2%; acquisition-led and volatile.

name: DO & CO Aktiengesellschaft
reason: Premium airline/event caterer with EPS EUR 2.96 (2015) to 9.82 (2025) but losses in 2019-20, EBIT margin at a 10y high (8.5% vs 3.1% avg), heavy Turkish Airlines/TRY dependence and lumpy one-off event contracts; hard to forecast 5-10 years out.
